info.name: Data Enrichment & Research Engine
info.description:
# Data Enrichment & Research Engine API Collection

Production-oriented Postman collection for validating, testing, and evaluating the **Data Enrichment & Research Engine** (`research-service`).

## Architectural Highlights
- **100% Real API Alignment**: Mapped directly against Spring Boot endpoints (`/api/v1/research`, `/api/v1/research/jobs`, `/actuator/health`, `/actuator/info`).
- **Zero Fictional Endpoints**: No synthetic or unsupported paths.
- **Robust Behavior-Driven Assertions**: Validates schemas, deterministic identity URNs/hashes, provenance tracking, and RFC 7807 ProblemDetail contracts without brittle exact-text couplings.
- **Sparse-to-Enriched Validation**: Evaluates the core product capability—turning sparse, noisy, or ungrounded input into evidence-backed, confidence-tiered knowledge graphs.

## Variables
All requests reference `{{baseResearchUrl}}`.
- Default: `http://localhost:8080`
- Standalone Local Spring Boot Port: `http://localhost:9741`
